name: Claude Code team on verification loops: E2E tests, separate graders and hooks let agents check their own work, up to 10 points better task success in internal tests
title: Claude Code team on verification loops: E2E tests, separate graders and hooks let agents check their own work, up to 10 points better task success in internal tests
summary: An article shared by Addy Osmani describes how the Claude Code team (about 90% of its code written and reviewed by Claude) has agents verify work with end-to-end tests, rubric graders and review hooks. It reports a separate grader improving structured file generation success by up to 10 points over a standard prompting loop.
